tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The complete authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Other details can be seen in the tender document.
Tender Application amount will not be refundable
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only. More details should be collected from the office at working hours

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder/Tenderer should have supplied same or similar category of items for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Urban local bodies/Public Listed Company. Work done certificate should be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder must submit PAN card

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs.49.20 Lakhs in the previous five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) The Tenderer should submit copy certified by Chartered Accountant along with UDIN number (If UDIN not verified online bidder will be disqualified)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should submit Certificate of registration of the Company under the companies act, 1956 or registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities under relevant act.

If the Tenderer should posses ISO registration certification and the copy of same should been closed (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 both are mandatory) (If ISO not verified online bidder will be disqualified)

Tenderer should be OEM Manufacturer or Authorized dealer- Should enclose Dealership Certificate or OEM Authorization Certificate for applicable items. Note-The Chemical manufacturer, who gives the authorization to the bidder, must be authorized by World Health Organization WHO. Supportive documents to be uploaded Udyam and other registration certificate of Manufacturer.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Tenderer should be OEM Manufacturer or Authorized dealer

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1.Trade License 2Chemicals supplier must compulsorily enclose License to sell, Stock or Exhibit for Sale or Distribute Insecticides for Commercial Pest Control Operations ( Form VII)

Tenderer firm/company should not be blacklisted by any government organization. The Tenderer shall furnish an Affidavit (for the current financial year) for not having Black Listed earlier by the Firm / Company represented by its Proprietor / Partners / Directors / Chairman / Managing Director / Office Bearers in the Business Transactions of any Government / Semi- Government / Government Undertaking / Public Sector Organizations / any other Departments.
